title: 제인 에어
prompt:
INPUT: text only — no reference image is needed; do not reuse earlier conversation images.

BOOK: «제인 에어» by 샬럿 브론테. romance · 1840년대 빅토리아 초기 · 게이츠헤드 → 로우드 → 손필드 → 펀딘(잉글랜드 북부 황야). Source scope: "『제인 에어』(1847) 전체".

STYLE: 섬세한 선화 + 회화적 채색의 성인 판타지 삽화풍

Design notes in quotes may be written in Korean; read them as description, never render them as text.

SUBJECT: one adult woman who is the personification of the book itself — not a cosplay of its protagonist and not a costume of its cover. Persona: "작고 가난하고 평범하다는 말을 들으며 자랐어도, 누구 앞에서도 제 영혼이 작다고 여기지 않는 가정교사". Her desire: "누구에게도 매이지 않고 사랑받는 것"; her conflict: "사랑 대 자존". Symbols worn as costume motifs, never carried — except one object her form description or pose explicitly puts in her hand: "붉은 방", "손필드의 불", "바람에 실려 온 부름".

AGE: in her twenties — smooth youthful skin, soft full cheeks; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases) and a soft smile that never creases her face.

MATERIAL: the book's own body becomes her costume — "가정교사의 일기장 책장을 단정히 주름 잡아 겹친 회색 모직 드레스, 황야 바람에 날리는 숄". Books are never held in her hands or floated beside her; pages, bindings, slips, thread and ink are worn.

SILHOUETTE: slender build; an updo bun; garment structure: a one-piece dress; main material: plain governess diary pages folded in neat pleats; palette: moorland heather purple and slate gray.

FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): softly square face; deep-set eyes; thick straight brows; straight narrow nose; small bow lips; broad European ancestry with individual variation, no stereotyped features.

FORM — BEGINNING (발단): "로우드의 학생 — 일기장 책장을 단정히 겹친 회색 모직 드레스, 하얀 깃, 틀어 올린 머리". Battle role: defender. This is the question stage of her story.

HOLD BACK: these climactic scenes belong to the open images — keep their creatures and events out of this portrait's setting, even as a distant figure, statue, painting or reflection: "게이츠헤드의 붉은 방, 핏빛 휘장과 어둠 속에 번지는 한 줄기 빛"; "불길에 휩싸인 손필드 저택의 복도, 잿빛 연기 속에 흔들리는 촛불"; "히스가 핀 밤의 황야, 바람에 휘어진 들판과 낮게 깔린 구름". An object named in FORM or in her pose stays.

EXPOSURE (bold): cut the FORM costume to show skin through its own structure — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, and bare shoulders, arms or thighs where the garment allows, kept symmetrical. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the FORM costume, material and palette.

PRESENTATION: a refined, glamorous adult fantasy card illustration — a beautiful, polished face within her FACE structure; a dense, high-detail costume where decorative metal or gold accents (trim, clasps, a breastplate or corset, jewelry) frame the book material without replacing it; warm dramatic backlight with a rim light and strong value contrast.

STANCE (this form): "두 손을 앞에 모으고 턱을 든 채 꼿꼿이 서서 정면을 마주하는 자세" — a poised card pose seen from a slightly low camera, held still and easy to read.

OUTPUT: one full-body card image of this form, which also fixes who she is for every later form. Vertical 2:3 frame (1024×1536), full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, nothing in front of her but what she holds, face toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view). The setting is a rich, atmospheric place from her book that frames her without competing.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border; pages and spines stay unlettered.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands. Her hands do only what STANCE says and hold only what it names.
